description: Add RFC4180-style field quoting/escaping to a CSV row builder that currently joins fields with no escaping at all
prompts: csvutil.js's toCsvRow(fields) just does fields.join(',') - a field containing a comma, a double quote, or a newline corrupts the row. Fix it: a field must be wrapped in double quotes if it contains a comma, a double quote, or a newline (\n); any double quote INSIDE such a field must be escaped by doubling it (" becomes ""); a field with none of those characters stays bare (unquoted). Fields are still joined with commas between them.
name: add_js_csv_safe_writer
